text.skill: Charges toward a target within {Range} range at {Speed} speed, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and [cc]stunning[/] them for {Stun}s.
text.skill2: Stomps the ground, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies within {Range} range, then applying a {Slow}% [cc]slow[/] for {SlowTime}s.
text.ult: Slams the ground, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies within {Range} range and [cc]knocking them airborne[/] for {Time}s.

text.skill: Targets one enemy and [cc]taunts[/] them for {Time}s.
text.skill2: Grants themself a [shield]shield[/] for {Time}s. ([shield]Shield[/] value: [hp]{Coef}% maximum health[/] + [shield]{Amount}[/]). While the shield holds, [phys]reflects {Reflect}% of damage taken[/].
text.ult: Summons a defensive area with {Range} range at the target location for [num]{Time}s[/]. Allies inside the area have their damage taken reduced by [shield]{Coef}%[/] + [hp]{HpCoef}% maximum health[/], while enemies inside are [cc]slowed by {MoveSpeedReduce}%[/].

text.skill: Fires a sword wave, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies hit. (Sword wave range: {Range})
text.skill2: Slashes a single target three times in succession, dealing heavy [phys]physical damage[/]. Each hit deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] damage.
text.ult: Dashes {Range} distance in a straight line, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies in the dash path. The damage is split between enemies hit. If this ultimate kills an enemy, its cooldown is reset.

text.skill: Leaps in the targeted direction, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to the most recently attacked enemy.
text.skill2: Fires an arrow at a nearby enemy, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% attack damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/], briefly [cc]stunning[/] them, then jumps backward.
text.ult: Stop in place and fire a total of {Count} arrows. Each arrow flies toward a random enemy within {Range} range, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% attack damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].

text.skill: Each time Sniper levels up, gains [range]{GrowthRange} range[/].
text.skill2: Fires three consecutive shots at one enemy, dealing heavy [phys]physical damage[/]. (Per shot: [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] damage). This ability’s range scales with basic attack range.
text.ult: Fires a giant bullet in a straight line, sniping an enemy within {Range} range. The bullet deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies in its path, with damage reduced by {Decay}% each time it hits an enemy.

text.skill: Creates a healing field with {Range} range for {Duration}s, restoring [hp]{Value}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] [hp]health[/] to allies standing on it every {Tick}s.
text.skill2: Grants one ally a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Value}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] for {Time}s. While the shield holds, the ally gains [aspd]{AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed[/].
text.ult: Flies into the air and becomes fixed in place for {Time}s, firing a healing projectile every {Tick}s at the lowest-health ally within ultimate range. The projectile restores [hp]{Value}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] [hp]health[/].

text.skill: Restores one ally’s health by [hp]{Value}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/].
text.skill2: Restores one ally’s health by [hp]{Value}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] and deals [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{DamageCoef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies within {Range} range around that ally.
text.ult: Summons a Spirit Gate. The Spirit Gate fires projectiles that either restore [hp]{Value}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] health to allies within {Range} range, or deal [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{DamageCoef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies.

text.skill: Restores [hp]{Value}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] [hp]health[/] to nearby allies within {Range} range. If Monk only heals themself, the healing amount increases to [hp]{SingleValue}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/].
text.skill2: Slams the ground with their palm, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies within {Range} range and [cc]stunning them for {Time}s[/].
text.ult: Grants nearby allies within {Range} range a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Shield}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/]. Shielded allies gain [speed]{MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed[/].

text.skill: Drops a fireball, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies within {Range} range.
text.skill2: Summons a flame field in the target area for {Duration}s, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] every {Tick}s to enemies within {Range} range.
text.ult: Creates a massive explosion within {Range} range, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to all enemies in the blast area.

text.skill: Freezes an enemy, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and [cc]stunning[/] them for {Time}s.
text.skill2: Summons an ice field in the target area for {Duration}s, [cc]slowing[/] enemies within {Range} range by {MoveSpeed}% and dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] every {Tick}s. When the field expires, enemies in range are frozen and [cc]stunned[/] for {Stun}s.
text.ult: Deals [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies in a cone and knocks them back. [cc]Slows[/] them by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s and [cc]prevents them from using movement abilities[/] for {BlockDuration}s.

text.skill: Fires a shadow orb, then charges at the enemy hit, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.skill2: Charges a short distance toward the target enemy, becoming untargetable and attacking three times in succession. Each attack deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.ult: Charges at an enemy within {Range} range, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].

text.skill: Detonates magic energy in a long, narrow line, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/].
text.skill2: Creates an arcane core in a small area for {Duration}s, pulling enemies within {Range} slightly toward its center every {Tick}s and dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/].
text.ult: For [num]{Time}s[/], gains [range]{Range} range[/] and [aspd]{AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed[/] + [magic]{AttackSpeedCoef}% Ability Power[/]. Each basic attack triggers their first Ability.

text.skill: Enters a rage for {Duration}s, increasing [aspd]Attack Speed by {AttackSpeed}%[/] and gaining [hp]{Vamp}% Life Steal[/].
text.skill2: Slams the ground with both hands, launching enemies in a narrow area [cc]airborne for {Time}s[/] and dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.ult: Rushes toward an enemy within {Range} range and strikes them down, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. Cooldown is reduced in proportion to lost [hp]Health[/].

text.skill: Fires a hook, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies hit and pulling them toward the user.
text.skill2: Slashes an enemy with a hook, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and causing them to [cc]bleed for {Duration}s[/]. Bleeding enemies take [phys]{TickDamage}[/] + [phys]{TickCoef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] every {Tick}s, and their damage taken is [cc]increased by {Debuff}%[/].
text.ult: Sweeps enemies in a semicircle within {Range} in front with a hook, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and rendering them [cc]unable to heal for {Time}s[/].

text.skill: Knocks back nearby enemies within {Range} range, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.skill2: Charges a short distance, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Value}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to an enemy, then passes through them and moves behind them.
text.ult: Charges {Range} distance, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies hit and [cc]knocking them airborne[/] for {Time}s.

text.skill: Each time Ogre takes damage from an enemy champion, gains [hp]{Value} maximum health[/].
text.skill2: Slams a single target with a club, [cc]stunning them for {Time}s[/] and dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] + [hp]{HpCoef}% maximum health[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.ult: Becomes gigantic for {Time}s, increasing [hp]maximum health by {Buff}%[/] + [hp]{HpCoef}% maximum health[/].

text.skill: Fires a sword wave in a straight line, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies hit and [cc]rooting[/] them for {Time}s.
text.skill2: Dashes to an [cc]immobilized[/] enemy within {Range} range, launching them [cc]airborne for {Time}s[/] and dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.ult: Slashes an enemy within the targeted {Range} range, dealing [num]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [num]true damage[/] {Count} times.

text.skill: Charges in a straight line, impaling the first enemy hit with a spear, [cc]rooting[/] them for {Time}s and dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. Charge speed scales with Movement Speed.
text.skill2: For {Time}s, gains [speed]{Speed}% Movement Speed[/] and empowers their weapon into a flaming spear. Attacks deal additional burn damage equal to [phys]{BurnDamage}[/] + [phys]{BurnCoef}% Attack Damage[/] for {BurnTime}s.
text.ult: For {Time}s, gains [speed]{Speed}% Movement Speed[/] + [phys]{SpeedCoef}% Attack Damage[/] and creates a path leading to Cavalry’s position. Allies on the path gain [speed]{Buff}% Movement Speed[/] + [phys]{SpeedCoef}% Attack Damage[/] while moving toward Cavalry.

text.skill: Can attack enemies while moving. From level 3, attacking an enemy grants [speed]{Value}% Movement Speed[/] for {Time}s.
text.skill2: Empowers attacks for {Time}s, increasing [phys]Attack Damage by {Attack}[/]. Every third attack causes the bullet to [cc]slow[/] the enemy by {Slow}% for {SlowTime}s.
text.ult: Empowers attacks for {Time}s, increasing [phys]Attack Damage by {Attack}[/] and firing additional bullets at 2 enemies near the attack target. Additional bullets deal [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].

text.skill: Jumps at an enemy and slams down with the pole, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.skill2: Moves a short distance and vaults onto the pole, becoming untargetable for {Time}s before swinging the pole and dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all nearby enemies within {Range} range.
text.ult: Charges at a target enemy within {Range} range, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and [cc]knocking the target airborne for {Time}s[/].

text.skill: Summons a small jiangshi that rushes at enemies and attacks them. The small jiangshi disappears after 3 attacks, with each attack dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.skill2: Slams the enemy, [cc]stunning[/] them for {Time}s, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/], and [hp]restoring {Heal} health[/].
text.ult: For [num]{Duration}s[/], drains [hp]health[/] equal to [hp]{Heal}[/] + [magic]{HealCoef}% Ability Power[/] from enemies within {Range} range, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{DamageCoef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/].

text.skill: Rolls a die, attacking enemies within {Range} range a number of times equal to the roll. Each attack deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.skill2: Throws a chip, creating a {AttackRange}-size area within {Range} range that [cc]slows[/] enemies by {Slow}% for {Time}s. When the area expires, it explodes, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies in range.
text.ult: Fires a pile of money in a straight line, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies hit and [cc]charming[/] them for {Time}s.

text.skill: Swings a hammer at one nearby enemy, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and [cc]knocking them airborne for {Time}s[/].
text.skill2: Raises the hammer and channels briefly before slamming the ground, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to nearby enemies within {Range} range and [cc]slowing them by {Move}% for {Time}s[/].
text.ult: Swings the hammer in a wide arc, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies in a forward semicircle within {Range} range. Enemies hit by the hammer are knocked back for {Time}s, and enemy champions they collide with are [cc]knocked airborne for {Airborne}s[/].

text.skill: A hellish claw rises from the ground to grab an enemy, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and swapping positions with them.
text.skill2: Transforms into a greater demon for {Time}s. While transformed, increases [phys]Attack by {Attack}[/], [armor]Armor by {Defense}[/], [aspd]Attack Speed by {AttackSpeed}%[/], and [speed]Movement Speed by {MoveSpeed}%[/].
text.ult: Deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies within {Range} range and [cc]fears[/] them for {Time}s.

text.skill: Drains an enemy’s blood, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/], [hp]restoring {Heal} health[/], and gaining a stack. Each stack [hp]increases healing by {Stack}[/].
text.skill2: Consumes {Value}% of their own health to spray blood in a cone, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/]. Damage increases by {Stack} per stack.
text.ult: Becomes untargetable and dashes {Range} distance, [hp]draining {Heal}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] [hp]health[/] from each enemy in the dash path and dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{DamageCoef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/].

text.skill: Attaches a spirit to an ally, restoring [hp]{Heal}[/] + [magic]{HealRatio}% Ability Power[/] [hp]health[/] every [num]{Tick}s[/] for [num]{Duration}s[/] and increasing [speed]Movement Speed by {SpeedUp}%[/].
text.skill2: Attaches a spirit to an enemy, reducing their [armor]Armor[/] by {DefDown} + [magic]{DefCoef}% Ability Power[/] and [mr]Magic Resistance[/] by {MrDown} + [magic]{MrCoef}% Ability Power[/] for [num]{Duration}s[/], and [cc]slowing[/] them by {Slow}%.
text.ult: Detonates attached spirits. Allied spirits grant a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Shield}[/] + [magic]{ShieldCoef}% Ability Power[/] and [aspd]{AttackSpeed}% increased Attack Speed[/]. Enemy spirits deal [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{DamageCoef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and [cc]stun[/] for {StunTime}s.

text.skill: Throws a boomerang in a straight line, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. At the end of its range, the boomerang spins in place, continuously dealing [phys]{DotDamage}[/] + [phys]{DotCoef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies it touches.
text.skill2: Throws boomerangs in three directions. The boomerangs travel out and return, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies in their path.
text.ult: Fires a powerful boomerang in a straight line, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. On hitting an enemy champion, it bounces toward the nearest other enemy champion, and its damage increases by [phys]{Increase}%[/] with each bounce. Bounces up to {MaxBounce} times.

text.skill: Dashes a short distance, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to the first enemy hit and applying [cc]bleed[/].
text.skill2: Slashes a target enemy, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. If the enemy is [cc]bleeding[/], Ability 1’s cooldown is reset.
text.ult: Charges at a nearby enemy champion, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies around the arrival point. Enemies reduced to {Threshold}% maximum health or below are executed. If an enemy is executed, nearby enemies are [cc]feared for {FearTime}s[/].

text.skill: Grants a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Shield}[/] + [hp]{Coef}% maximum health[/] to the user and one target ally within range. (Lasts {Duration}s)
text.skill2: Takes [cc]{Damage}%[/] of the damage received by nearby allies instead of them, and slows enemies who attack those allies by [cc]{Coef}%[/] + [armor]{DefCoef}% Armor[/]. (Lasts {Duration}s)
text.ult: On use, gains [shield]{DamageReduce}% damage reduction[/] + [mr]{MrCoef}% Magic Resistance[/] and crowd-control immunity for {Duration}s, then [cc]taunts[/] all enemies in a wide area around them for {TauntDuration}s. Cannot move while taunting.

text.skill: Strikes an enemy with a whip, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/], plus damage equal to [hp]{HpRatio}% of the target’s health[/].
text.skill2: Swings a whip in a cone, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies in range and knocking them back.
text.ult: Channels for [num]{Duration}s[/], repeatedly firing straight-line piercing projectiles toward random enemies in range, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].

text.skill: Slashes enemies in a crescent-shaped area in front of them, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and [hp]healing for {HealRatio}% of the damage dealt[/].
text.skill2: Charges forward, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies hit and [cc]slowing[/] them by {Slow}% for {SlowTime}s.
text.ult: For [num]{Duration}s[/], repeatedly deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies in a cone in the target direction, and applies [cc]Bleed for {BleedTime}s[/]. Bleed: [phys]{BleedDamage}[/] + [phys]{BleedCoef}% Attack Damage[/]

text.skill: Empowers the club for [num]{Duration}s[/], causing attacks to release a cone-shaped shockwave. The shockwave deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.skill2: Hardens their skin for [num]{Duration}s[/], granting a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Shield}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] and [shield]{DamageReduction}% damage reduction[/].
text.ult: Fires a projectile in a straight line, gradually [cc]slowing enemies hit over {SlowTime}s[/] before [cc]rooting them for {BindTime}s[/]. When the root is applied, deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to nearby enemies, spreading the same effect to enemies damaged.

text.skill: Summons a ghoul as a minion for [num]{Duration}(+{DurationCoef}% Ability Power)s[/]. This ability’s cooldown decreases with level, and the ghoul’s duration increases by [num]{DurationPerLevel}s[/] per level.
text.skill2: Marks one enemy as the ghoul’s attack target for [num]{Time}s[/], causing the ghoul to go berserk. The ghoul gains [aspd]{AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed[/] + [magic]{AttackSpeedCoef}% Ability Power[/] and [speed]{MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed[/] + [magic]{MoveSpeedCoef}% Ability Power[/].
text.ult: Revives a dead allied champion as a wraith. While the summon is maintained, it loses [hp]{HpDrain} health[/] every second.

text.skill: Increase one ally's [aspd]attack speed by {AttackSpeed}%[/] + [magic]{Coef}% ability power[/] for [num]{Duration}s[/].
text.skill2: Reduces the skill cooldowns of allies within the targeted area by [num]{CoolReduce}%[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] for {Duration}s.
text.ult: Channels for [num]{Duration}s[/], increasing the [phys]Attack Damage[/] of allied champions within {Range} range by [phys]{Attack}[/](+[magic]{AttackRatio}% Ability Power[/]), [magic]Ability Power[/] by {MagicPower}, and [aspd]Attack Speed[/] by {AttackSpeed}%, while reducing ability cooldowns by {CoolReduce}%. However, their [armor]Armor[/] is reduced by {DefenceReduce}% and their [mr]Magic Resistance[/] is reduced by {MagicResistanceReduce}%.

text.skill: Creates a barrier in the target area for [num]{Duration}s[/], granting allies inside it a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Shield}[/] + [magic]{ShieldCoef}% Ability Power[/] and reducing enemies’ [aspd]Attack Speed by {AttackSpeedReduce}%[/]. From level 3, the barrier’s area increases, and allies inside it gain additional [aspd]Attack Speed[/] while enemies are [cc]slowed[/].
text.skill2: Summons a barrier lasting [num]{Duration}s[/] in the targeted area that destroys all projectiles inside.
text.ult: Creates a shrinking circular barrier around an enemy champion. Enemies who touch the barrier’s edge take [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and are [cc]stunned for {Time}s[/].

text.skill: Throws a kitchen knife in a straight line, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and [cc]slowing[/] enemies hit by {Slow}% for {SlowTime}s.
text.skill2: Shares food with nearby allies, continuously [hp]restoring health[/] equal to [hp]{Heal}[/] + [magic]{HealCoef}% Ability Power[/]. If only healing themself, the amount increases to [hp]{SelfHeal}[/] + [magic]{SelfHealCoef}% Ability Power[/].
text.ult: Throws a special dish to an allied champion, increasing their [hp]maximum health by {HpRatio}%[/] for [num]{Duration}s[/]. [shield]{SpreadRatio}%[/] of incoming damage is spread out as damage over time.

text.skill: Teleports beside the target. If the target is an enemy, deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and increases [speed]movement speed by {MoveSpeed}%[/] for [num]{Duration}s[/].
text.skill2: Scatters daggers around them, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies in range. (Can move while using this ability)
text.ult: Enters a frenzy for [num]{Time}s[/], turning all daggers into special daggers that ricochet between enemies.

text.skill: Throws a chakram at an enemy, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. Each added chakram increases this skill's damage by {StackCoef}%.
text.skill2: Each kill adds a chakram to basic attacks. (Max [num]{MaxCount}[/]; damage decreases by [num]{Reduce}%[/] with each consecutive added-chakram hit)
text.ult: Fires {Count}(+stacks) piercing chakrams in a cone, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. The chakrams return at the end of their path, dealing an additional [phys]{ReturnDamage}[/] + [phys]{ReturnCoef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. (Up to {MaxCount})

text.skill: Fires a dark arrow in a straight line, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies hit and [cc]rooting[/] them for {Time}s.
text.skill2: After a short delay, covers an area in darkness, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies within the area.
text.ult: Curses an enemy champion within {Range} range, linking them to the nearest allied champion for [num]{Duration}s[/]. When either linked target takes damage, [magic]{ShareRatio}%[/] of that damage is also transferred to the other linked target.

text.skill: Cleanses one ally of [cc]crowd-control effects[/] and restores [hp]{Heal}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] health. Removes stun, sleep, root, fear, charm, taunt, airborne and forced movement. Does not remove buff-based effects such as slows or poison.
text.skill2: Grants divine protection to one ally for [num]{Duration}s[/], increasing [phys]Attack Damage by {Attack}[/] and [aspd]Attack Speed by {AttackSpeed}%[/]. While protected, if the ally is hit by a crowd-control ability, the crowd-control effect is reflected back onto the attacker.
text.ult: Creates an explosion at the target location, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies in range. Deals an additional [magic]{BonusDamage}[/] + [magic]{BonusCoef}% Ability Power[/] damage for each buff on the target.

text.skill: Becomes untargetable and dashes in a straight line. On takedown participation, gains [phys]{Attack} Attack Damage[/], [aspd]{AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed[/], and [hp]restores {Heal} health[/].
text.skill2: Dashes a short distance, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to the first target hit. Can be recast up to {Time} times.
text.ult: Becomes immune to movement-impairing effects for [num]{Time}s[/]. On takedown participation, resets basic ability cooldowns.

text.skill: Fires a disorienting projectile, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and summoning an Illusionist clone in front of the enemy, [cc]taunting[/] them for {Time}s.
text.skill2: Deals [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies within {Range} range and [cc]fears[/] them for {Time}s.
text.ult: Creates an illusion of one nearby allied champion for [num]{Duration}s[/]. The illusion can only use basic attacks and has the same stats as the copied champion.

text.skill: Fires lightning at a target enemy, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/]. The lightning continues to chain to nearby targets within range and cannot hit the same target more than once.
text.skill2: Calls down lightning on the target area, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies hit and [cc]stunning[/] them for {Time}s.
text.ult: Channels a lightning beam at an enemy champion for [num]{Duration}s[/], [cc]stunning[/] them. Continuously deals [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to the target and nearby enemies.

text.skill: Injects themself and one allied champion, increasing [aspd]Attack Speed by {AttackSpeed}%[/] + [magic]{AttackSpeedCoef}% Ability Power[/] and [speed]Movement Speed by {MoveSpeed}%[/] for [num]{Duration}s[/].
text.skill2: Performs a procedure on one allied champion, increasing their [range]range[/] by {Range} + [magic]{RangeCoef}% Ability Power[/] for [num]{Duration}s[/] and causing their attacks to dash toward the target.
text.ult: Administers a forbidden elixir to one ally, reducing their current health by {HpReduceRatio}%. For {Duration}s, their health cannot fall below 1, and they gain [phys]{Attack} Attack Damage[/], [aspd]{AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed[/] + [magic]{AttackSpeedCoef}% Ability Power[/], and [speed]{MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed[/].

text.skill: Spreads a poison field, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies in range, poisoning them for [num]{Duration}s[/] and [cc]slowing them by {Slow}%[/].
text.skill2: When attacking a poisoned enemy, gains [range]{Range} range[/]. When moving away from a poisoned enemy, gains [speed]{Speed}% Movement Speed[/].
text.ult: Grants nearby allies’ attacks a poison effect for [num]{Duration}s[/]. The poison deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] over [num]{PoisonDuration}s[/].

text.skill: Black shadows emerge from the ground, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies in range and [cc]rooting them for {Time}s[/].
text.skill2: Explodes the shadow of an immobilized enemy, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/].
text.ult: Fires a piercing shadow projectile in a straight line, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemy champions hit and [cc]banishing them for {BanishTime}s[/].

text.skill: Seals an enemy with a talisman, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and [cc]preventing them from using basic attacks for {Time}(+{TimeCoef}% Ability Power)s[/].
text.skill2: Attaches a talisman to an enemy, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and [cc]silencing them for {Time}(+{TimeCoef}% Ability Power)s[/].
text.ult: Fires a talisman projectile in a straight line, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies hit, making them [cc]incapacitated for {Time}s[/] and untargetable. When the effect ends, it spreads to nearby enemies.

text.skill: Slams a mace down on the target, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. Deals {Bonus}% additional damage to structures.
text.skill2: Slams the ground with a mace, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies in range, including structures.
text.ult: For {Time}s, gains [phys]{Attack} Attack Damage[/], [aspd]{AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed[/], and [speed]{MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed[/].

text.skill: Fires a shockwave in a straight line. When the shockwave hits an enemy or reaches the end of its range, it explodes in an area, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies in range and applying a {Slow}% [cc]slow[/] for {Time}s.
text.skill2: Grants themself a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Shield}[/] + [hp]{Coef}% maximum health[/] for {Time}s. When the shield expires or breaks, enemies within {Range} range are [cc]stunned[/] for {StunTime}s.
text.ult: Grants a target ally within {Range} range a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Shield}[/] + [hp]{Coef}% maximum health[/]. After {Time}s, teleports to that ally.

text.skill: Summons a bear. If the bear dies, the Druid takes [phys]{DeathDamage}[/] + [magic]{DeathCoef}% Ability Power[/] damage. If used while the bear is summoned, restores the bear’s health by [hp]{Heal}[/] + [magic]{HealCoef}% Ability Power[/].
text.skill2: Summons an eagle. If the eagle dies, the Druid takes damage. If used while the eagle is summoned, the eagle charges at an enemy, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and [hp]healing for {Lifesteal}% of the damage dealt[/].
text.ult: Fires {Count} bear and eagle spirits in succession in the target direction. Each projectile deals [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and knocks enemies back.

text.skill: Throws an iron ball in a straight line, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies in range.
text.skill2: Roars, gaining a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Shield}[/] + [hp]{Coef}% maximum health[/] for {Time}s and [cc]taunting[/] all nearby enemies.
text.ult: Charges at a target enemy, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies around the landing point and [cc]stunning them for {Time}s[/].

text.skill: Throws a bomb, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies in range.
text.skill2: Plants a mine that is invisible to enemies. When an enemy steps on it, the mine deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and [cc]roots[/] them for {Time}s. The mine is not triggered by minions.
text.ult: Throws a large bomb at the target location, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to all enemies in range and [cc]slowing[/] them by {Slow}% for {SlowTime}s.

text.skill: Fires a cursed projectile, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/], [cc]slowing[/] enemies hit by {Slow}% for {Time}s, and reducing their [aspd]Attack Speed by {AtkSpd}%[/] for [num]{AtkSpdTime}s[/].
text.skill2: Curses a target enemy for [num]{Time}s[/], dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/]. While cursed, the target takes an additional [magic]{HitDmg}[/] + [magic]{HitCoef}% Ability Power[/] damage each time they are attacked. (Maximum {Max} times)
text.ult: Creates a voodoo area at the target location for [num]{Duration}s[/]. Enemies inside the area continuously take [hp]{HpRatio}% maximum health[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and are [cc]silenced, preventing them from using abilities[/].

text.skill: After a short delay, a straight-line beam explodes, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to all enemies in range.
text.skill2: Summons beams in a circular area, striking 5 times and dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies in range, [cc]slowing[/] them by {Slow}% for {SlowTime}s.
text.ult: Fires a piercing beam in a straight line, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies hit and [cc]rooting[/] them for {Time}s.

text.skill: Summons a whirlwind for [num]{Duration}s[/], dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] every {Tick}s to enemies within {Range} range. Allies inside the whirlwind gain [speed]{MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed[/].
text.skill2: Fires five whirlwinds forward, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies in range.
text.ult: Fires a giant whirlwind that slowly moves toward the nearest enemy champion. Enemies hit take [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and are [cc]knocked airborne for {AirborneTime}s[/]. Each time the whirlwind hits, its size, damage, and airborne duration decrease, then it redirects toward another enemy champion.

text.skill: Enhances an ally for [num]{Duration}s[/], [range]increasing range by {Increase}[/].
text.skill2: Enhances an ally’s equipment for [num]{Duration}s[/], increasing stats gained from items by [num]{Percent}%[/].
text.ult: Enhances an allied champion for {Duration}s, increasing [phys]Attack Damage by {Attack}[/](+[magic]{AttackRatio}% Ability Power[/]), [aspd]Attack Speed by {AttackSpeed}%[/], and [speed]Movement Speed by {MoveSpeed}%[/], and grants crowd-control immunity.

text.skill: Fires three consecutive shots. The first shot [cc]stuns the enemy for {StunTime}s[/], and each of the next two shots deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/].
text.skill2: Teleports behind the enemy champion most recently attacked within [num]{Range}[/] range.
text.ult: Marks an enemy champion, then after [num]{Duration}s[/] deals [phys]{Damage} + {Coef}% of the damage taken during the mark[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. If the target is killed, becomes stealthed for [num]{InvisibleDuration}s[/].

text.skill: Restores [hp]{Value}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] health to nearby allies.
text.skill2: Grants an ally a [shield]shield[/] equal to [shield]{Shield}[/] + [magic]{ShieldCoef}% Ability Power[/] and [speed]{MoveSpeed}% increased Movement Speed[/].
text.ult: Creates a sanctuary for [num]{Duration}s[/], continuously [hp]restoring[/] [hp]{HealValue}[/] + [magic]{HealCoef}% Ability Power[/] health to allies in range and granting them a resurrection shield.

text.skill: Teleports to an enemy and switches to ranged attack mode. [range]Range increases by {RangeIncrease}[/].
text.marks: Ranged basic attacks mark enemy champions for [num]{Duration}s[/]. Further hits refresh existing marks. The second skill can target enemies with 3 marks.
text.skill2: Charges at an enemy with 3 marks, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and [cc]silencing[/] them for {SilenceTime}s.
text.ult: Dashes forward, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies in its path. Can be cast once more for a short time after use. Participating in a takedown during this time grants one additional cast.

text.skill: Fires a blade in the target direction, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and [cc]slowing[/] enemies hit by {Slow}% for {SlowTime}s. Stores up to [num]{ChargeCount} charges[/] and gains [num]1 charge[/] when a basic attack hits an enemy champion.
text.skill2: For [num]{Duration}s[/], gains [speed]{MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed[/], [aspd]{AttackSpeed}% Attack Speed[/], and the ability to pass through walls.
text.ult: Charges at a target enemy, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. Deals [phys]{SplashDamage}[/] + [phys]{SplashCoef}% Attack Damage[/] area damage to nearby enemies, [cc]knocks them back[/], then disappears.

text.skill: Basic attacks carry sand energy, dealing [magic]{PassiveDamage}[/] + [magic]{PassiveCoef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]bonus magic damage[/]. This bonus damage and the sand eruption can critically strike. On use, erupts sand around the target, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]area magic damage[/].
text.skill2: Absorbs sand energy for [num]{Time}s[/], increasing [speed]Movement Speed by {Speed}%[/] + [magic]{SpeedCoef}% Ability Power[/] and [hp]healing self[/] for [hp]{Heal}[/] + [magic]{HealCoef}% Ability Power[/].
text.ult: Creates a sand swamp around the target for [num]{Duration}s[/]. Every {Tick}s, enemies inside take [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] and are pulled toward the center.

text.skill: Throws a flask that bursts and leaves a toxic pool for [num]{Time}s[/]. Enemies in the pool are [em]poisoned[/] for [num]{DotTime}s[/], taking [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] every {DotTick}s, and their healing is reduced by {HealReduce}%.
text.skill2: Injects one enemy with an unstable reagent, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/]. For [num]{Time}s[/], the target cannot be healed and is slowed by {Slow}%.
text.ult: Throws a toxic flask in a line. When it hits an enemy champion, it creates a poison cloud that expands up to {CloudRadius} range for [num]{CloudTime}s[/]. Enemies in the cloud are [em]poisoned[/] for [num]{DotTime}s[/], taking [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] every {DotTick}s, and lose [armor]{DefenceReduce}[/] + [magic]{DefenceCoef}% Ability Power[/] Armor and [mr]{MagicResistanceReduce}[/] + [magic]{MagicResistanceCoef}% Ability Power[/] Magic Resist.

text.skill: Fires a powerful arrow in a line, dealing [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to the first enemy champion hit. While the ultimate mark lasts, it deals an additional [phys]{MarkCoef}% Attack Damage[/].
text.skill2: Fires a piercing arrow forward in a line, dealing [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies, while being pushed back for [num]{BackstepTime}s[/]. While the ultimate mark lasts, it deals an additional [phys]{MarkCoef}% Attack Damage[/].
text.ult: Fires a tracer round in a line, dealing [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to the first enemy champion hit and marking them for [num]{Duration}s[/]. While the mark lasts, all skills hit the marked target regardless of distance and skill cooldowns are reduced by [num]{CoolReduce}%[/]. Other champions in the path can intercept.

text.skill: Fires a nightmare shard in a line, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to the first enemy hit. Can be used up to [num]{UseCount} times[/] in succession.
text.skill2: Dashes [num]{Range}[/] in the chosen direction, then deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies within [num]{Radius}[/] and becomes invisible for [num]{StealthTime}s[/].
text.ult: Dashes to the target enemy champion and deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/]. If this damage kills the target, teleports next to a living allied champion regardless of distance.

text.skill: Grabs one nearby enemy, throws them over his shoulder behind himself, and deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/], [cc]stunning them for {Stun}s[/].
text.skill2: Swings his barbell in a wide arc, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to enemies within [num]{Range}[/] and [cc]knocking them back[/].
text.ult: Throws one nearby allied champion to the target location. After landing, the thrown ally gains a [shield]{Shield} shield[/] for [num]{ShieldTime}s[/], and enemies within [num]{Radius}[/] of the landing point take [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and are [cc]stunned for {Stun}s[/]. If there is no nearby ally to throw, Strongman leaps instead; in this case, the stun lasts [cc]{SelfStun}s[/].

text.skill: Sweeps the greatsword across the front, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% of Attack[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and [cc]slowing by {Slow}% for {Time} seconds[/].
text.skill2: Charges a short distance and deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% of Attack[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to the first enemy hit. After the charge, [num]damage taken is reduced by {Reduce}% for {Time} seconds[/].
text.ult: Instantly destroys all shields on enemies within [num]{Range}[/]. An enemy whose shield is destroyed takes [magic]{BonusDamage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% of Magic Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/], is [cc]stunned for {Stun} seconds[/], and [num]cannot gain shields for {BlockTime} seconds[/]. An enemy without a shield instead takes only [magic]{Damage} magic damage[/].

text.skill: Calls down a meteor at the target location after [num]{Delay}s[/], dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies in the area and, for [cc]{SlowTime}s[/], reducing their Move Speed by [cc]{Slow}%[/].
text.skill2: Deals [magic]{LinkDamage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/] to enemies in a line and leaves a constellation mark. The mark lasts [num]{MarkTime}s[/], and marked enemies take additional damage from the Ultimate's constellation detonation.
text.ult: Draws a constellation in the target area and marks all enemies. After [num]{Delay}s[/], all marks explode simultaneously, dealing [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% Ability Power[/] as [magic]magic damage[/]. Damage increases by [num]{Amplify}%[/] for each additional linked enemy. Enemies that were already marked take an additional [magic]{MarkCoef}%[/] of Ability Power as damage.

text.skill: Fires a harpoon in a straight line, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] to the first enemy champion hit. For [num]{RecastDuration}s[/] after hitting, recast to pull yourself toward the target or pull the target toward you.
text.skill2: Fires a powerful harpoon in a straight line, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] + [hp]{HpCoef}%[/] of the target's missing Health as [phys]physical damage[/] to the first enemy hit.
text.ult: Fires [num]{ProjectileCount}[/] chained harpoons in a forward cone, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% Attack Damage[/] as [phys]physical damage[/] and binding those hit for [num]{LinkDuration}s[/]. Bound enemies are slowed by [cc]{Slow}%[/]. If they move more than [num]{LinkRange}[/] apart, the chains tighten: the slow increases to [cc]{TensionSlow}%[/] and they are dragged toward each other.

text.skill: Throw a net in a [num]{FanAngle}[/]-degree cone, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% AD[/] [phys]physical damage[/] and [cc]rooting[/] enemies for [num]{Stun}s[/].
text.skill2: Thrust forward for [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% AD[/] [phys]physical damage[/]. Hitting the same champion again within [num]{Time}s[/] adds [num]{Amplify}%[/] damage per stack, up to [num]{MaxAmplifyTargets}[/] stacks. Hitting another champion resets the chain.
text.ult: Rush an enemy champion, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% AD[/] [phys]physical damage[/] and [cc]taunting[/] for [num]{Stun}s[/]. The target cannot heal or gain new shields. Damage to the Gladiator from other enemies is reduced by [num]{Amplify}%[/]. Cleansing the taunt or killing the target ends the duel.

text.skill: Throw an anchor at the first champion in its path. Pull an ally at or below [num]{AllyHpRatio}%[/] health to your side and grant [num]{Amplify}%[/] movement speed for [num]{Time}s[/]; healthier allies are passed over. Enemies instead take [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% AP[/] [magic]magic damage[/] and are slowed by [num]{Slow}%[/] for [num]{SlowTime}s[/].
text.skill2: Create a river of length [num]{Range}[/] and width [num]{Width}[/] for [num]{Time}s[/]. Allies on it gain [num]{Amplify}%[/] movement speed; enemies are slowed by [num]{Slow}%[/].
text.ult: Cleanse an allied champion other than yourself at or below [num]{AllyHpRatio}%[/] health, then ferry them [num]{MoveDistance}[/] toward your base over [num]{Time}s[/]. The passenger is untargetable, cannot act, and is immune to movement control. On landing, heal [hp]{Damage}[/] + [hp]{Coef}% AP[/] and grant [num]{Slow}%[/] movement speed for [num]{SlowTime}s[/].

text.skill: Deploy or pack the cannon. Deployment prevents movement, adds [num]{MoveDistance}[/] basic attack and skill 2 range, and grants [phys]{Amplify}% AD[/]. Packing grants [num]{Slow}%[/] movement speed for [num]{Time}s[/].
text.skill2: Lob a shell at the target location, dealing [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% AD[/] [phys]physical damage[/] in a radius of [num]{Radius}[/] and slowing enemies by [num]{Slow}%[/] for [num]{SlowTime}s[/]. Deployment increases cast range.
text.ult: Fire [num]{ProjectileCount}[/] shells across the chosen area. Each deals [phys]{Damage}[/] + [phys]{Coef}% AD[/] [phys]physical damage[/] in a radius of [num]{ProjectileRadius}[/]. Deployment adds a further [num]{MoveDistance}[/] cast range. Crowd control interrupts the remaining shots.

text.skill: Send a piercing pendulum forward for [magic]{Damage}[/] + [magic]{Coef}% AP[/] [magic]magic damage[/] and a [num]{Slow}%[/] slow lasting [num]{SlowTime}s[/]. This damage does not wake [cc]sleep[/]ing enemies.
text.skill2: After [num]{Delay}s[/], put enemies within radius [num]{Radius}[/] to [cc]sleep[/] for [num]{Time}s[/]. Sleep prevents movement and actions. Damage, including damage over time, wakes the target and that first hit deals [num]{Amplify}%[/] increased damage.
text.ult: After [num]{Delay}s[/], put enemies within radius [num]{Radius}[/] to [cc]sleep[/] for [num]{Time}s[/]. Damage wakes the target and the waking hit deals [num]{Amplify}%[/] increased damage. Cleanse removes both [cc]sleep[/] and its damage bonus.
